packageRules.description: Database majors need a manual dump/restore or pg_upgrade; an in-place tag bump breaks the data directory (see the reverted immich Postgres 14->16 bump).
Meilisearch refuses to start on a database from a different minor version without a dump/migration.

nfs-gateway's rclone binary is copied from rclone/rclone's own image and is CGO-linked against its build glibc/libfuse - confirmed to segfault immediately (even on --version) when run on debian:13-slim. Pinned to a digest instead of just the floating 12-slim tag so Renovate still proposes real Debian 12 point-release/security rebuilds; only the major jump to 13 is blocked.

Automerge minor, patch and digest updates once they are 2 days old, during the day. Renovate waits for the validate check to pass; majors stay manual. Renovate only gets release dates for Docker Hub images (and Helm charts, Go modules etc.); without minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour timestamp-optional, updates from ghcr.io, quay.io, lscr.io and code.forgejo.org never pass the age check and sit under 'Pending Status Checks' forever. Those now go through without the 2-day wait.
Tekton operator images are released together; one PR instead of one per image.
Helm in the validate workflow only renders charts for CI; Argo CD uses its own bundled Helm. Stay on Helm 3 (still get 3.x minors/patches) so CI renders like Argo.
Node in the validate workflow only runs renovate-config-validator. Track the Node LTS line that Renovate itself supports (26, Active LTS); take 26.x updates, move majors by hand.
